author: mettafort
text:
I'm no elite, I'm a cadet. I'm proud of it, and to be honest, there
are people here that have shaped me and touched me and we havent even
shared directly a single word. But I know my future can never not have
that experience of that persons knowledge be within my mind; any
progress I might make in new associations would be because of the input
of the many people I have learnt from already; the shoulders of giants.
 We are all giants here, because we joined here because of a common
theme, and it is deeper than Traders Helping Traders; its even more
human than that. We want to help each other, because together as
brothers and sisters, we can all float higher together, knowing we not
only *took* to rise, but *gave* to push out.

My dreams of what I want out of life have this year have become more
solid because of the existence of RTM and the mentors here. Before I
found RTM I was lost, and had spent more than I should have on stuff
that offered nothing in return. Ironically, my most profitable trade,
after spending a lot of money on signals and professional trading
strategies, was one that I discovered myself through many long hours on
the computer, deep into the depth of night. Sometimes I would have
realizations but more often, I just grew cold from the darkness of not
being able to see something, just something. And then one day I saw
something, and it worked repeatedly, and it was my first time that I
actually got to understand more about money management - before this I
had heard about it, but I still wasnt clued up. I was just early on in
the journey, thats all. Yet I moved forward, I learnt what was good
about my pattern and what was bad about it. I even began to see how if,
 I could spot this pattern n times, and x times where profitable at a
ratio of at least 2x the risk, then I potentially hold in my hands
something that could truly change the course of my life forever. And
while this is further on the journey, it is nowhere near where it needs
to be. But now, at this stage where I have at least held in my hand the
hope that I could change my destiny by taking control of my career and
finances in this way, then that is powerful.

But it should never be about the price, it is ultimately ever only about
 the goal...that reward. If it doesnt magnify well the risk, then
theres no trade. Simple economics. And if you think doing a course
would be false economics, thats perfect. If you think doing a course
would be a life changer; thats perfect. There is no destination without
 the source; kill the source and the destination is gone.

Namaste.

MF

author: Ifmyante
text:
That's basically it

Most of my analysis comes in after the trade is entered.

Before taking the trade, I do as you said - simple - it's really easy to
 find pockets of orders which will bounce price, and if they happen to
be at great htf levels, even better - there's the highest chance of them
 giving maximum pips.

What I do certainly looks like touch trading - picking tops and bottoms,
 but what you said belies that. These are not tops and bottoms, but
retraces to the best price to re enter.

Once I'm in though, I'm never guaranteed massive returns - sure price
will bounce where I enter, but I'm never complacent until I've seen the
engulf. In fact, I'm never really complacent at all. If PA tells me to
get out, I must get out!

journal, but I thought I would post it here to see what you had to say.
Your last EUR/JPY trade is puzzling to me. I have attached your chart
below with some markings on it.

I found similar work on the EUR/GBP. I hope I did it right...... . Since I am shorting high in the previous up move, I am high on the curve and shorting after a big up move.

This last chart shows the 240 for entry and why price might have spiked
up to where it did. The main thing here is to look at the FTR ( I think)
 from when price re-enters the daily zone. My guess is that you would
try to enter at the base of that FTR at the decision point. That spiked
candle also engulfs the source of the up move meaning you could short up
 at the blue ellipse too.

Thanks,

H
